result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position: it creates matching caps of the greater of USD 1,000,000 and fees paid or payable during the applicable 12-month period, retains a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, and makes the required confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross-negligence, wilful-misconduct, fraud, and IP-infringement claims uncapped. It also excludes Customer payment obligations from the liability limitations and appropriately removes IBM's blanket data-loss exclusion. The changes are substantially limited to those needed by the playbook and preserve the surrounding allocation of liability. Drafting is generally professional, though the payment treatment is somewhat duplicative of Section 10, and the cap period is tied to the first related claim rather than expressly to each claim as stated in the preferred position.
